_comment: THE token-lint rule, in one place (APE-4). Two consumers read these patterns and
- web/src/design/tokenLintRule.ts  — lints the HOST frontend (web/src) in vitest;
- personalclaw/apps/quality.py     — lints an APP BUNDLE's frontend so a
`quality.designSystem: "v2"` declaration can be verified in the apps-repo CI.
Reimplementing the rule on the app side would have minted a second dialect of the
same lint — the exact declared-vs-actual drift this atom exists to prevent — so the
patterns live here and web/src/design/tokenLintRuleParity.test.ts fails if the TS
copy stops matching this file byte for byte.
